en.bilal-muhammad: `Ali b. Ahmad b. Musa (rh) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Abi `Abdullah al-Kufi narrate to us from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Salih al-Razi from Hamdan al-Diwani. He said: Al-Rida (as) said:

Whoever visits me despite the distance, I will meet him in three places on the Day of Resurrection so that I may deliver him from its terrors: (1) when the Book is given to his right and left hand, (2) at the Path, and (3) at the Scale.
